notes: Compatibility shims document legacy authority paths that may remain during migration. They must be read/write classified and removed when the target transition boundary is live.

shims.read_permission: Allowed for layout routing and footer context selection while AppState focus_shape migration is incomplete.
shims.write_permission: Write only from transition commit after the active panel focus_shape has been updated.
shims.removal_trigger: All Enter, Tab, and F8 paths route through the canonical AppState transition entry point.
shims.follow_up_task: Move focus-shape authority from session mirrors into panel-local transition records.
shims.qa_enforcement: check_appstate_contract.py validates shim coverage and links it to an existing transition id.

shims.read_permission: Allowed only inside render projection or bounds-correction code after identity restore has run.
shims.write_permission: Never write authoritative selection from this calculation.
shims.removal_trigger: Render paths accept explicit projection inputs and no longer inspect restore authority fields directly.
shims.follow_up_task: Audit render/reflow call sites for projection-only behavior during runtime migration.
shims.qa_enforcement: check_appstate_contract.py requires render shims to declare no-write authority and target transition linkage.
